ko.title: [농업 101 #15] 적은 자원으로 더 많은 사람들 먹이기: 지속 가능한 농업, 스마트 팜, 그리고 전체 학기 정리

segments.src: > One-line summary: Sustainable agriculture keeps land productive for the long haul, and smart farms use sensors, data, and precise inputs to grow more food with less waste.
segments.tr: > 한 줄 요약: 지속 가능한 농업은 토지를 장기간 생산성 있게 유지하고, 스마트 팜은 센서, 데이터, 정밀한 투입물을 사용해 적은 낭비로 더 많은 식량을 재배합니다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: For most of the last century, "better farming" often meant "more" — more fertilizer, more water, more machinery, bigger fields.
segments.tr: 지난 100년 대부분 동안 "더 좋은 농업"은 종종 "더 많은" 것을 의미했습니다 — 더 많은 비료, 더 많은 물, 더 많은 기계, 더 큰 들판입니다.

segments.src: It worked, and yields soared.
segments.tr: 효과가 있었고, 수확량이 급증했습니다.

segments.src: But it also came with a bill: eroded topsoil, polluted rivers, drained aquifers, and rising costs.
segments.tr: 하지만 그것은 대가를 치르게 했습니다: 토양 침식, 오염된 강, 고갈된 대수층, 그리고 상승하는 비용입니다.

segments.src: Sustainable agriculture is the response.
segments.tr: 지속 가능한 농업이 그 응답입니다.

segments.src: The idea is simple to state and hard to master: produce food in a way that stays profitable, protects the environment, and can keep going for generations without exhausting the resources it depends on.
segments.tr: 그 아이디어는 말하기는 간단하지만 숙달하기는 어렵습니다: 식량을 생산하되 수익성이 있고, 환경을 보호하며, 의존하는 자원을 소진하지 않으면서 세대를 거쳐 계속할 수 있는 방식으로 생산하는 것입니다.

segments.src: Three related ideas do most of the work here.
segments.tr: 여기에서는 세 가지 관련된 아이디어가 대부분의 일을 합니다.

segments.src: - **Eco-friendly (sustainable) practices** aim to protect soil, water, and biodiversity. Think crop rotation, cover crops, reduced tillage, composting, and using fewer synthetic chemicals. Healthy soil holds water, stores carbon, and resists pests better.
segments.tr: - **친환경(지속 가능한) 관행**은 토양, 물, 생물 다양성을 보호하는 것을 목표로 합니다. 윤작, 피복 작물, 최소 경운, 퇴비화, 그리고 더 적은 합성 화학약품 사용을 생각해보세요. 건강한 토양은 물을 보유하고, 탄소를 저장하며, 해충에 더 잘 저항합니다.

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture** replaces "treat the whole field the same" with "treat each spot exactly as it needs." GPS-guided tractors, variable-rate sprayers, and yield maps let a farmer apply water, seed, or fertilizer only where and when it helps — cutting waste and cost.
segments.tr: - **정밀 농업**은 "전체 들판을 같게 취급하기"를 "각 지점을 정확히 필요한 대로 취급하기"로 바꿉니다. GPS로 유도되는 트랙터, 변량 분사기, 수확량 지도를 통해 농부는 물, 종자, 또는 비료를 필요한 곳과 시간에만 적용할 수 있습니다 — 낭비와 비용을 줄입니다.

segments.src: - **ICT convergence (the smart farm)** ties it together with technology: soil-moisture sensors, weather stations, drones, cameras, and software. Data flows in, software analyzes it, and equipment (or the farmer's phone) acts on it. A greenhouse that automatically adjusts temperature, humidity, and irrigation based on live readings is a classic smart farm.
segments.tr: - **ICT 수렴(스마트 팜)**은 기술로 이를 연결합니다: 토양 수분 센서, 기상 관측소, 드론, 카메라, 그리고 소프트웨어. 데이터가 유입되고, 소프트웨어가 이를 분석하며, 장비(또는 농부의 휴대폰)가 이에 따라 행동합니다. 실시간 판독값을 기반으로 온도, 습도, 관개를 자동으로 조정하는 온실은 클래식 스마트 팜입니다.

segments.src: Put plainly: sustainability sets the goal (last a long time without wrecking the land), and precision plus ICT are the tools that make hitting that goal realistic instead of just idealistic.
segments.tr: 명확하게 말하자면: 지속 가능성은 목표(장시간 토지를 망치지 않으면서 지속)를 설정하고, 정밀성과 ICT는 그 목표를 달성 가능한 현실로 만드는 도구들입니다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상생활 속에서

segments.src: Picture a mid-size farm in Iowa growing corn and soybeans.
segments.tr: 아이오와에서 옥수수와 대두를 재배하는 중간 규모 농장을 상상해보세요.

segments.src: A generation ago, the farmer spread the same amount of nitrogen fertilizer across all 500 acres — some spots got too much (wasting money and running off into the Mississippi watershed), others too little.
segments.tr: 한 세대 전에 농부는 모든 500에이커에 같은 양의 질소 비료를 뿌렸습니다 — 일부 지점은 너무 많이(돈을 낭비하고 미시시피 유역으로 유출), 다른 곳은 너무 적게.

segments.src: Today the same farm might run differently.
segments.tr: 오늘날 같은 농장이 다르게 운영될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A drone flies over in early summer and images the crop; software flags the pale, underperforming patches.
segments.tr: 드론이 여름 초에 날아다니며 작물을 촬영하고; 소프트웨어는 옅은, 저조한 패치에 표시합니다.

segments.src: The tractor's GPS auto-steers to the inch, and a variable-rate applicator dials the fertilizer up in hungry zones and down in healthy ones.
segments.tr: 트랙터의 GPS는 인치 단위로 자동 조종하고, 변량 분사기는 배고픈 지역에서는 비료를 늘리고 건강한 지역에서는 줄입니다.

segments.src: Soil sensors text the farmer when moisture drops.
segments.tr: 토양 센서는 수분이 떨어지면 농부에게 문자를 보냅니다.

segments.src: Over the season this can trim input costs by tens of dollars per acre — real money when diesel runs a few dollars a gallon and fertilizer prices swing hard — while keeping less nitrogen out of local streams.
segments.tr: 이 시즌 동안 에이커당 수십 달러의 투입 비용을 절감할 수 있습니다 — 디젤유가 갤런당 몇 달러이고 비료 가격이 크게 변할 때 진짜 돈 — 지역 시냇물에서 더 적은 질소를 유지하면서.

segments.src: Scale it down and it's your backyard too: a smart sprinkler that checks the forecast before watering, or a garden moisture probe on your phone, is the same principle.
segments.tr: 규모를 축소하면 당신의 뒷마당도 마찬가지입니다: 급수 전에 일기 예보를 확인하는 스마트 스프링클러, 또는 휴대폰에 연결된 정원 수분 프로브는 같은 원리입니다.

segments.src: Sense the actual need, then apply exactly that much.
segments.tr: 실제 필요를 감지하고, 그 정도만 적용합니다.

segments.src: That is precision and ICT working for a home gardener instead of a 500-acre operation.
segments.tr: 그것이 정밀성과 ICT가 500에이커 작업 대신 집 정원사를 위해 작동하는 방식입니다.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 세 줄 요약

segments.src: 1. Sustainable agriculture means producing food profitably and long-term without exhausting soil, water, and biodiversity.
segments.tr: 1. 지속 가능한 농업은 토양, 물, 생물 다양성을 소진하지 않으면서 식량을 수익성 있게 그리고 장기간 생산하는 것을 의미합니다.

segments.src: 2. Precision agriculture applies inputs site-specifically ("only where needed"), cutting waste and cost.
segments.tr: 2. 정밀 농업은 투입물을 지점 특정적으로(「필요한 곳에만」) 적용하여 낭비와 비용을 줄입니다.

segments.src: 3. Smart farms use ICT — sensors, data, and automation — to sense conditions and respond precisely and quickly.
segments.tr: 3. 스마트 팜은 ICT — 센서, 데이터, 자동화 — 를 사용하여 조건을 감지하고 정밀하고 빠르게 응답합니다.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 자가 진단

segments.src: 1. Which best describes the core goal of sustainable agriculture?
segments.tr: 1. 지속 가능한 농업의 핵심 목표를 가장 잘 설명하는 것은 무엇입니까?

segments.src: - A) Maximize this year's yield at any cost
segments.tr: - A) 비용에 상관없이 올해의 수확량을 최대화하기

segments.src: - B) Produce food long-term while protecting soil, water, and biodiversity
segments.tr: - B) 토양, 물, 생물 다양성을 보호하면서 장기간 식량 생산하기

segments.src: - C) Replace all farming with laboratory-grown food
segments.tr: - C) 모든 농업을 실험실에서 재배한 식량으로 대체하기

segments.src: - D) Farm only without any machinery
segments.tr: - D) 기계 없이만 농사하기

segments.src: 2. Precision agriculture is mainly about applying the same amount of every input evenly across the whole field. (O / X)
segments.tr: 2. 정밀 농업은 주로 전체 들판에 모든 투입물의 같은 양을 고르게 적용하는 것입니다. (O / X)

segments.src: 3. Which is the clearest example of a "smart farm"?
segments.tr: 3. 다음 중 "스마트 팜"의 가장 명확한 예시는 무엇입니까?

segments.src: - A) A greenhouse that auto-adjusts irrigation and temperature from live sensor data
segments.tr: - A) 실시간 센서 데이터로 관개와 온도를 자동으로 조정하는 온실

segments.src: - B) A field plowed by a horse-drawn plow
segments.tr: - B) 말이 끄는 쟁기로 경작한 들판

segments.src: - C) A market stand selling vegetables
segments.tr: - C) 야채를 판매하는 시장 가판대

segments.src: - D) A warehouse storing harvested grain
segments.tr: - D) 수확된 곡물을 보관하는 창고

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Sustainable agriculture**: Farming that stays productive and profitable long-term while protecting soil, water, and ecosystems.
segments.tr: - **지속 가능한 농업**: 토양, 물, 생태계를 보호하면서 장기간 생산성이 있고 수익성 있게 유지되는 농업입니다.

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture**: Managing fields site-specifically so inputs (water, seed, fertilizer) go only where and when they are needed.
segments.tr: - **정밀 농업**: 투입물(물, 종자, 비료)이 필요한 곳과 시간에만 가도록 들판을 지점 특정적으로 관리하는 것입니다.

segments.src: - **ICT convergence / smart farm**: Combining sensors, data, and automation so a farm can monitor conditions and respond in real time.
segments.tr: - **ICT 수렴 / 스마트 팜**: 센서, 데이터, 자동화를 결합하여 팜이 조건을 모니터링하고 실시간으로 응답할 수 있도록 하는 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Variable-rate application**: Adjusting the amount of an input across a field based on local need, rather than a single fixed rate.
segments.tr: - **변량 적용**: 고정 비율이 아니라 현지 필요에 따라 들판 전체에 투입물의 양을 조정하는 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Cover crop**: A plant grown mainly to protect and enrich the soil between main harvests, not to be sold.
segments.tr: - **피복 작물**: 주로 주요 수확 사이에 토양을 보호하고 풍부하게 하기 위해 재배되며, 판매되지 않는 식물입니다.

segments.src: *Answers: 1) B — sustainability is about long-term productivity plus environmental protection, not maximizing one season.
segments.tr: *답변: 1) B — 지속 가능성은 한 시즌을 최대화하는 것이 아니라 장기 생산성과 환경 보호에 관한 것입니다.

segments.src: 2) X — it is the opposite; precision means varying inputs by location instead of applying a uniform amount.
segments.tr: 2) X — 반대입니다; 정밀성은 균일한 양을 적용하는 것 대신 위치에 따라 투입물을 변화시키는 것을 의미합니다.

segments.src: 3) A — a sensor-driven, self-adjusting greenhouse is the textbook smart farm; the others lack the sense-analyze-act loop.*
segments.tr: 3) A — 센서 기반, 자동 조정 온실은 교과서적 스마트 팜입니다; 다른 것들은 감지-분석-행동 루프가 부족합니다.*

segments.src: Semester wrap-up: across these 15 lectures we moved from what agriculture is, through soil, water, plants, crops, livestock, and pests, and arrived here — where all of it comes together under one question: how do we keep feeding a growing world without using up the planet that feeds us?
segments.tr: 학기 정리: 이 15개의 강의를 통해 우리는 농업이 무엇인지에서부터 시작하여, 토양, 물, 식물, 작물, 가축, 해충을 거쳐 여기에 도착했습니다 — 이 모든 것이 하나의 질문 아래 모이는 곳: 우리는 우리를 먹여 사는 행성을 사용하지 않으면서 증가하는 세계를 어떻게 계속 먹여 살릴까요?

segments.src: Sustainable, precise, data-driven farming is today's best working answer.
segments.tr: 지속 가능하고, 정밀하고, 데이터 기반의 농업이 오늘날의 최고의 작동 답변입니다.

zh.title: [农业基础 101 第15讲] 用更少资源养活更多人：可持续农业、智能农场和全学期总结

segments.src: > One-line summary: Sustainable agriculture keeps land productive for the long haul, and smart farms use sensors, data, and precise inputs to grow more food with less waste.
segments.tr: > 一句话总结：可持续农业让土地长期保持高产，智能农场通过传感器、数据和精准投入以更少的浪费种植更多食物。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今天的概念

segments.src: For most of the last century, "better farming" often meant "more" — more fertilizer, more water, more machinery, bigger fields.
segments.tr: 在过去大部分世纪里，"更好的农业"常常意味着"更多"——更多肥料、更多水、更多机械、更大的田地。

segments.src: It worked, and yields soared.
segments.tr: 这奏效了，产量飙升。

segments.src: But it also came with a bill: eroded topsoil, polluted rivers, drained aquifers, and rising costs.
segments.tr: 但它也付出了代价：土壤侵蚀、河流污染、地下水枯竭和成本上升。

segments.src: Sustainable agriculture is the response.
segments.tr: 可持续农业是回应。

segments.src: The idea is simple to state and hard to master: produce food in a way that stays profitable, protects the environment, and can keep going for generations without exhausting the resources it depends on.
segments.tr: 这个想法说起来简单，做起来难：以一种保持盈利、保护环境、并且可以世代延续而不消耗其所依赖资源的方式生产食物。

segments.src: Three related ideas do most of the work here.
segments.tr: 三个相关的想法在这里做了大部分工作。

segments.src: - **Eco-friendly (sustainable) practices** aim to protect soil, water, and biodiversity. Think crop rotation, cover crops, reduced tillage, composting, and using fewer synthetic chemicals. Healthy soil holds water, stores carbon, and resists pests better.
segments.tr: - **生态友好（可持续）实践**旨在保护土壤、水和生物多样性。想想轮作、覆盖作物、减少耕作、堆肥和使用更少的合成化学品。健康的土壤能保持水分、储存碳，并更好地抵抗害虫。

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture** replaces "treat the whole field the same" with "treat each spot exactly as it needs." GPS-guided tractors, variable-rate sprayers, and yield maps let a farmer apply water, seed, or fertilizer only where and when it helps — cutting waste and cost.
segments.tr: - **精准农业**用"根据每个位置的具体需求处理"替代了"用同样方式处理整个田地"。GPS导向的拖拉机、变量喷洒器和产量地图让农民只在需要的地点和时间应用水、种子或肥料——减少浪费和成本。

segments.src: - **ICT convergence (the smart farm)** ties it together with technology: soil-moisture sensors, weather stations, drones, cameras, and software. Data flows in, software analyzes it, and equipment (or the farmer's phone) acts on it. A greenhouse that automatically adjusts temperature, humidity, and irrigation based on live readings is a classic smart farm.
segments.tr: - **ICT融合（智能农场）**用技术把它们结合在一起：土壤水分传感器、气象站、无人机、摄像头和软件。数据流入，软件分析它，设备（或农民的手机）根据它采取行动。一个根据实时读数自动调整温度、湿度和灌溉的温室是典型的智能农场。

segments.src: Put plainly: sustainability sets the goal (last a long time without wrecking the land), and precision plus ICT are the tools that make hitting that goal realistic instead of just idealistic.
segments.tr: 简单地说：可持续性设定目标（长期持续而不破坏土地），精准性加上ICT是使实现该目标现实而不仅仅是理想的工具。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活中

segments.src: Picture a mid-size farm in Iowa growing corn and soybeans.
segments.tr: 想象一个位于爱荷华州的中等规模农场种植玉米和大豆。

segments.tr: 一代人之前，农民在所有500英亩上均匀撒播同样数量的氮肥——有些地方太多了（浪费金钱并流入密西西比河流域），有些地方太少。

segments.src: Today the same farm might run differently.
segments.tr: 今天同一个农场可能以不同的方式运营。

segments.tr: 一架无人机在初夏飞过并给作物拍照；软件标记出苍白的、表现欠佳的区域。

segments.src: Scale it down and it's your backyard too: a smart sprinkler that checks the forecast before watering, or a garden moisture probe on your phone, is the same principle.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 三行总结

segments.src: 1. Sustainable agriculture means producing food profitably and long-term without exhausting soil, water, and biodiversity.
segments.tr: 1. 可持续农业意味着以盈利和长期的方式生产食物，而不消耗土壤、水和生物多样性。

segments.tr: 2. 精准农业特定地应用投入（"仅在需要的地方"），减少浪费和成本。

segments.src: 3. Smart farms use ICT — sensors, data, and automation — to sense conditions and respond precisely and quickly.
segments.tr: 3. 智能农场使用ICT——传感器、数据和自动化——来感测条件并精准和快速地做出反应。

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今天的术语

segments.src: - **Sustainable agriculture**: Farming that stays productive and profitable long-term while protecting soil, water, and ecosystems.
segments.tr: - **可持续农业**：保持长期生产和盈利，同时保护土壤、水和生态系统的农业。

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture**: Managing fields site-specifically so inputs (water, seed, fertilizer) go only where and when they are needed.
segments.tr: - **精准农业**：特定地管理田地，以使投入（水、种子、肥料）仅在需要的地点和时间进行。

segments.src: - **ICT convergence / smart farm**: Combining sensors, data, and automation so a farm can monitor conditions and respond in real time.
segments.tr: - **ICT融合/智能农场**：结合传感器、数据和自动化，以使农场可以监测条件并实时响应。

segments.src: - **Variable-rate application**: Adjusting the amount of an input across a field based on local need, rather than a single fixed rate.
segments.tr: - **变量施用**：根据当地需求在田地上调整投入数量，而不是单一固定速率。

segments.src: - **Cover crop**: A plant grown mainly to protect and enrich the soil between main harvests, not to be sold.
segments.tr: - **覆盖作物**：主要为了保护和丰富主收获之间的土壤而种植的植物，不用于销售。

hi.title: [Agriculture 101 #15] कम संसाधनों से अधिक लोगों को खिलाना: टिकाऊ खेती, स्मार्ट खेत, और सेमेस्टर सारांश

segments.src: > One-line summary: Sustainable agriculture keeps land productive for the long haul, and smart farms use sensors, data, and precise inputs to grow more food with less waste.
segments.tr: > एक-पंक्ति सारांश: टिकाऊ कृषि भूमि को लंबे समय तक उत्पादक रखती है, और स्मार्ट खेत अधिक भोजन उगाने के लिए कम अपशिष्ट के साथ सेंसर, डेटा और सटीक इनपुट का उपयोग करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## आज की अवधारणा

segments.src: For most of the last century, "better farming" often meant "more" — more fertilizer, more water, more machinery, bigger fields.
segments.tr: पिछली सदी के अधिकांश समय के लिए, "बेहतर खेती" अक्सर "अधिक" का अर्थ था — अधिक उर्वरक, अधिक पानी, अधिक मशीनरी, बड़े खेत।

segments.src: It worked, and yields soared.
segments.tr: यह काम करता था, और पैदावार बढ़ गई।

segments.src: But it also came with a bill: eroded topsoil, polluted rivers, drained aquifers, and rising costs.
segments.tr: लेकिन इसके साथ एक कीमत भी आई: मिट्टी का कटाव, प्रदूषित नदियाँ, सूखे जलभृत, और बढ़ती लागत।

segments.src: Sustainable agriculture is the response.
segments.tr: टिकाऊ कृषि प्रतिक्रिया है।

segments.src: The idea is simple to state and hard to master: produce food in a way that stays profitable, protects the environment, and can keep going for generations without exhausting the resources it depends on.
segments.tr: यह विचार सरल है लेकिन मास्टर करना कठिन है: ऐसे तरीके से भोजन का उत्पादन करें जो लाभजनक रहे, पर्यावरण की रक्षा करे, और पीढ़ियों तक उन संसाधनों को समाप्त किए बिना जारी रह सके जिन पर यह निर्भर है।

segments.src: Three related ideas do most of the work here.
segments.tr: यहाँ तीन संबंधित विचार अधिकांश काम करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Eco-friendly (sustainable) practices** aim to protect soil, water, and biodiversity. Think crop rotation, cover crops, reduced tillage, composting, and using fewer synthetic chemicals. Healthy soil holds water, stores carbon, and resists pests better.
segments.tr: - **ईको-फ्रेंडली (टिकाऊ) प्रथाएं** मिट्टी, पानी और जैव विविधता की रक्षा करने का लक्ष्य रखती हैं। फसल चक्र, कवर फसलें, कम जुताई, खाद बनाना, और कम कृत्रिम रसायनों का उपयोग सोचें। स्वस्थ मिट्टी पानी रखती है, कार्बन संग्रहीत करती है, और कीटों का बेहतर प्रतिरोध करती है।

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture** replaces "treat the whole field the same" with "treat each spot exactly as it needs." GPS-guided tractors, variable-rate sprayers, and yield maps let a farmer apply water, seed, or fertilizer only where and when it helps — cutting waste and cost.
segments.tr: - **सटीक कृषि** "पूरे खेत को एक समान मानो" को "प्रत्येक स्थान को बिल्कुल वैसे ही मानो जैसे उसे चाहिए" से बदल देता है। GPS-निर्देशित ट्रैक्टर, परिवर्तनशील दर स्प्रेयर, और पैदावार मानचित्र किसान को पानी, बीज, या उर्वरक केवल वहीं और तभी लागू करने देते हैं जहां और जब यह मदद करता है — अपशिष्ट और लागत में कटौती करते हुए।

segments.src: - **ICT convergence (the smart farm)** ties it together with technology: soil-moisture sensors, weather stations, drones, cameras, and software. Data flows in, software analyzes it, and equipment (or the farmer's phone) acts on it. A greenhouse that automatically adjusts temperature, humidity, and irrigation based on live readings is a classic smart farm.
segments.tr: - **आईसीटी अभिसरण (स्मार्ट खेत)** इसे प्रौद्योगिकी के साथ बांधता है: मिट्टी-नमी सेंसर, मौसम स्टेशन, ड्रोन, कैमरे, और सॉफ्टवेयर। डेटा अंदर बहता है, सॉफ्टवेयर इसका विश्लेषण करता है, और उपकरण (या किसान का फोन) इस पर कार्य करता है। एक ग्रीनहाउस जो लाइव रीडिंग के आधार पर तापमान, आर्द्रता, और सिंचाई को स्वचालित रूप से समायोजित करता है, एक क्लासिक स्मार्ट खेत है।

segments.src: Put plainly: sustainability sets the goal (last a long time without wrecking the land), and precision plus ICT are the tools that make hitting that goal realistic instead of just idealistic.
segments.tr: स्पष्ट रूप से कहें: स्थिरता लक्ष्य निर्धारित करती है (लंबे समय तक चलें बिना भूमि को नुकसान पहुंचाए), और सटीकता और आईसीटी वे उपकरण हैं जो उस लक्ष्य को हिट करना केवल आदर्शवादी के बजाय यथार्थवादी बनाता है।

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## रोजमर्रा की जिंदगी में

segments.src: Picture a mid-size farm in Iowa growing corn and soybeans.
segments.tr: आयोवा में मकई और सोयाबीन उगाने वाले मध्यम आकार के खेत की कल्पना करें।

segments.src: A generation ago, the farmer spread the same amount of nitrogen fertilizer across all 500 acres — some spots got too much (wasting money and running off into the Mississippi watershed), others too little.
segments.tr: एक पीढ़ी पहले, किसान सभी 500 एकड़ में समान मात्रा में नाइट्रोजन उर्वरक फैलाता था — कुछ स्थानों को बहुत अधिक मिला (पैसा बर्बाद करते हुए और मिसिसिप्पी वाटरशेड में भाग जाते हुए), दूसरों को बहुत कम।

segments.src: Today the same farm might run differently.
segments.tr: आज उसी खेत को अलग तरीके से चलाया जा सकता है।

segments.src: A drone flies over in early summer and images the crop; software flags the pale, underperforming patches.
segments.tr: एक ड्रोन गर्मियों की शुरुआत में फसल की तस्वीरें लेने के लिए उड़ता है; सॉफ्टवेयर पीले, कम प्रदर्शन वाले पैच को झंडी देता है।

segments.src: The tractor's GPS auto-steers to the inch, and a variable-rate applicator dials the fertilizer up in hungry zones and down in healthy ones.
segments.tr: ट्रैक्टर का GPS इंच तक ऑटो-स्टीयर करता है, और एक परिवर्तनशील दर आवेदक भूखे क्षेत्रों में उर्वरक को अधिक करता है और स्वस्थ क्षेत्रों में कम करता है।

segments.src: Soil sensors text the farmer when moisture drops.
segments.tr: मिट्टी के सेंसर किसान को संदेश भेजते हैं जब नमी गिरती है।

segments.src: Over the season this can trim input costs by tens of dollars per acre — real money when diesel runs a few dollars a gallon and fertilizer prices swing hard — while keeping less nitrogen out of local streams.
segments.tr: इस मौसम में यह प्रति एकड़ दसियों डॉलर से इनपुट लागत को ट्रिम कर सकता है — वास्तविक पैसा जब डीजल कुछ डॉलर प्रति गैलन चलता है और उर्वरक की कीमतें कठिन झूलती हैं — जबकि स्थानीय धाराओं से कम नाइट्रोजन रखते हुए।

segments.src: Scale it down and it's your backyard too: a smart sprinkler that checks the forecast before watering, or a garden moisture probe on your phone, is the same principle.
segments.tr: इसे कम करें और यह आपका बैकयार्ड भी है: एक स्मार्ट स्प्रिंकलर जो सिंचाई से पहले पूर्वानुमान की जांच करता है, या आपके फोन पर एक बगीचे की नमी जांच, समान सिद्धांत है।

segments.src: Sense the actual need, then apply exactly that much.
segments.tr: वास्तविक आवश्यकता को समझें, फिर बिल्कुल उतना ही लागू करें।

segments.src: That is precision and ICT working for a home gardener instead of a 500-acre operation.
segments.tr: यह सटीकता और आईसीटी एक 500 एकड़ के ऑपरेशन के बजाय एक घर के माली के लिए काम कर रही है।

es.title: [Agricultura 101 #15] Alimentar a más personas con menos recursos: Agricultura sostenible, granjas inteligentes y un resumen del semestre completo

segments.src: > One-line summary: Sustainable agriculture keeps land productive for the long haul, and smart farms use sensors, data, and precise inputs to grow more food with less waste.
segments.tr: > Resumen de una línea: La agricultura sostenible mantiene la tierra productiva a largo plazo, y las granjas inteligentes utilizan sensores, datos e insumos precisos para producir más alimentos con menos desperdicio.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concepto de hoy

segments.src: For most of the last century, "better farming" often meant "more" — more fertilizer, more water, more machinery, bigger fields.
segments.tr: Durante la mayor parte del último siglo, "mejor agricultura" a menudo significaba "más" — más fertilizante, más agua, más maquinaria, campos más grandes.

segments.src: It worked, and yields soared.
segments.tr: Funcionó, y los rendimientos se dispararon.

segments.src: But it also came with a bill: eroded topsoil, polluted rivers, drained aquifers, and rising costs.
segments.tr: Pero también tuvo un costo: suelo erosionado, ríos contaminados, acuíferos agotados y costos crecientes.

segments.src: Sustainable agriculture is the response.
segments.tr: La agricultura sostenible es la respuesta.

segments.src: The idea is simple to state and hard to master: produce food in a way that stays profitable, protects the environment, and can keep going for generations without exhausting the resources it depends on.
segments.tr: La idea es simple de enunciar y difícil de dominar: producir alimentos de una manera que sea rentable, proteja el ambiente y pueda continuar durante generaciones sin agotar los recursos de los que depende.

segments.src: Three related ideas do most of the work here.
segments.tr: Tres ideas relacionadas hacen la mayor parte del trabajo aquí.

segments.src: - **Eco-friendly (sustainable) practices** aim to protect soil, water, and biodiversity. Think crop rotation, cover crops, reduced tillage, composting, and using fewer synthetic chemicals. Healthy soil holds water, stores carbon, and resists pests better.
segments.tr: - **Prácticas ecológicas (sostenibles)** tienen como objetivo proteger el suelo, el agua y la biodiversidad. Piensa en rotación de cultivos, cultivos de cobertura, labranza reducida, compostaje y uso de menos químicos sintéticos. El suelo saludable retiene agua, almacena carbono y resiste mejor a las plagas.

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture** replaces "treat the whole field the same" with "treat each spot exactly as it needs." GPS-guided tractors, variable-rate sprayers, and yield maps let a farmer apply water, seed, or fertilizer only where and when it helps — cutting waste and cost.
segments.tr: - **Agricultura de precisión** reemplaza "tratar todo el campo igual" con "tratar cada punto exactamente como lo necesita". Los tractores guiados por GPS, pulverizadores de tasa variable y mapas de rendimiento permiten a un agricultor aplicar agua, semilla o fertilizante solo donde y cuándo ayuda — reduciendo desperdicio y costo.

segments.src: - **ICT convergence (the smart farm)** ties it together with technology: soil-moisture sensors, weather stations, drones, cameras, and software. Data flows in, software analyzes it, and equipment (or the farmer's phone) acts on it. A greenhouse that automatically adjusts temperature, humidity, and irrigation based on live readings is a classic smart farm.
segments.tr: - **Convergencia de TIC (la granja inteligente)** lo une todo con tecnología: sensores de humedad del suelo, estaciones meteorológicas, drones, cámaras y software. Los datos fluyen, el software los analiza y el equipo (o el teléfono del agricultor) actúa sobre ellos. Un invernadero que ajusta automáticamente la temperatura, humedad e irrigación basado en lecturas en tiempo real es una granja inteligente clásica.

segments.src: Put plainly: sustainability sets the goal (last a long time without wrecking the land), and precision plus ICT are the tools that make hitting that goal realistic instead of just idealistic.
segments.tr: Dicho claramente: la sostenibilidad establece el objetivo (durar mucho tiempo sin arruinar la tierra), y la precisión más TIC son las herramientas que hacen que lograr ese objetivo sea realista en lugar de solo idealista.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## En la vida cotidiana

segments.src: Picture a mid-size farm in Iowa growing corn and soybeans.
segments.tr: Imagina una granja de tamaño medio en Iowa que cultiva maíz y soja.

segments.src: A generation ago, the farmer spread the same amount of nitrogen fertilizer across all 500 acres — some spots got too much (wasting money and running off into the Mississippi watershed), others too little.
segments.tr: Hace una generación, el agricultor esparcía la misma cantidad de fertilizante nitrogenado en los 500 acres — algunos lugares recibían demasiado (desperdiciando dinero y escurriéndose hacia la cuenca del Misisipí), otros muy poco.

segments.src: Today the same farm might run differently.
segments.tr: Hoy la misma granja podría funcionar de manera diferente.

segments.src: A drone flies over in early summer and images the crop; software flags the pale, underperforming patches.
segments.tr: Un dron sobrevuela a principios de verano e imagena el cultivo; el software marca los parches pálidos y de bajo rendimiento.

segments.src: The tractor's GPS auto-steers to the inch, and a variable-rate applicator dials the fertilizer up in hungry zones and down in healthy ones.
segments.tr: El GPS del tractor se autodirige hasta la pulgada, y un aplicador de tasa variable ajusta el fertilizante hacia arriba en zonas con demanda y hacia abajo en las saludables.

segments.src: Soil sensors text the farmer when moisture drops.
segments.tr: Los sensores del suelo envían un mensaje de texto al agricultor cuando la humedad baja.

segments.src: Over the season this can trim input costs by tens of dollars per acre — real money when diesel runs a few dollars a gallon and fertilizer prices swing hard — while keeping less nitrogen out of local streams.
segments.tr: Durante la temporada, esto puede reducir los costos de insumos en decenas de dólares por acre — dinero real cuando el diésel cuesta unos pocos dólares por galón y los precios de fertilizante fluctúan mucho — mientras mantiene menos nitrógeno fuera de los arroyos locales.

segments.src: Scale it down and it's your backyard too: a smart sprinkler that checks the forecast before watering, or a garden moisture probe on your phone, is the same principle.
segments.tr: Reduce la escala y también es tu patio trasero: un aspersor inteligente que verifica el pronóstico antes de regar, o una sonda de humedad del jardín en tu teléfono, es el mismo principio.

segments.src: Sense the actual need, then apply exactly that much.
segments.tr: Detecta la necesidad real, luego aplica exactamente esa cantidad.

segments.src: That is precision and ICT working for a home gardener instead of a 500-acre operation.
segments.tr: Esa es la precisión y TIC funcionando para un jardinero casero en lugar de una operación de 500 acres.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Resumen de tres líneas

segments.src: 1. Sustainable agriculture means producing food profitably and long-term without exhausting soil, water, and biodiversity.
segments.tr: 1. Agricultura sostenible significa producir alimentos de manera rentable y a largo plazo sin agotar el suelo, el agua y la biodiversidad.

segments.src: 2. Precision agriculture applies inputs site-specifically ("only where needed"), cutting waste and cost.
segments.tr: 2. Agricultura de precisión aplica insumos específicamente por sitio ("solo donde se necesita"), reduciendo desperdicio y costo.

segments.src: 3. Smart farms use ICT — sensors, data, and automation — to sense conditions and respond precisely and quickly.
segments.tr: 3. Las granjas inteligentes utilizan TIC — sensores, datos y automatización — para detectar condiciones y responder de manera precisa y rápida.

segments.tr: ## ✅ Autoevaluación

segments.tr: - A) Maximizar el rendimiento de este año a cualquier costo

segments.tr: - B) Producir alimentos a largo plazo mientras se protege el suelo, el agua y la biodiversidad

segments.tr: - C) Reemplazar toda la agricultura con alimentos cultivados en laboratorio

segments.tr: 3. ¿Cuál es el ejemplo más claro de una "granja inteligente"?

segments.tr: - A) Un invernadero que ajusta automáticamente el riego y la temperatura a partir de datos de sensores en tiempo real

segments.tr: - B) Un campo arado con un arado tirado por caballos

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Términos de hoy

segments.src: - **Sustainable agriculture**: Farming that stays productive and profitable long-term while protecting soil, water, and ecosystems.
segments.tr: - **Agricultura sostenible**: Agricultura que se mantiene productiva y rentable a largo plazo mientras protege el suelo, el agua y los ecosistemas.

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture**: Managing fields site-specifically so inputs (water, seed, fertilizer) go only where and when they are needed.
segments.tr: - **Agricultura de precisión**: Gestionar campos de manera específica al sitio para que los insumos (agua, semilla, fertilizante) vayan solo donde y cuándo se necesitan.

segments.src: - **ICT convergence / smart farm**: Combining sensors, data, and automation so a farm can monitor conditions and respond in real time.
segments.tr: - **Convergencia de TIC / granja inteligente**: Combinar sensores, datos y automatización para que una granja pueda monitorear condiciones y responder en tiempo real.

segments.src: - **Variable-rate application**: Adjusting the amount of an input across a field based on local need, rather than a single fixed rate.
segments.tr: - **Aplicación de tasa variable**: Ajustar la cantidad de un insumo en un campo basado en la necesidad local, en lugar de una tasa fija única.

segments.src: - **Cover crop**: A plant grown mainly to protect and enrich the soil between main harvests, not to be sold.
segments.tr: - **Cultivo de cobertura**: Una planta cultivada principalmente para proteger y enriquecer el suelo entre las cosechas principales, no para vender.

segments.src: *Answers: 1) B — sustainability is about long-term productivity plus environmental protection, not maximizing one season.
segments.tr: *Respuestas: 1) B — la sostenibilidad trata sobre la productividad a largo plazo más la protección ambiental, no maximizar una temporada.

segments.src: 2) X — it is the opposite; precision means varying inputs by location instead of applying a uniform amount.
segments.tr: 2) N — es lo opuesto; la precisión significa variar insumos por ubicación en lugar de aplicar una cantidad uniforme.

segments.src: 3) A — a sensor-driven, self-adjusting greenhouse is the textbook smart farm; the others lack the sense-analyze-act loop.*
segments.tr: 3) A — un invernadero impulsado por sensores y auto-ajustable es la granja inteligente de manual; los otros carecen del ciclo de sensibilización-análisis-acción.*

segments.src: Semester wrap-up: across these 15 lectures we moved from what agriculture is, through soil, water, plants, crops, livestock, and pests, and arrived here — where all of it comes together under one question: how do we keep feeding a growing world without using up the planet that feeds us?
segments.tr: Resumen del semestre: a través de estas 15 conferencias nos movimos desde qué es la agricultura, pasando por suelo, agua, plantas, cultivos, ganadería y plagas, y llegamos aquí — donde todo se une bajo una pregunta: ¿cómo continuamos alimentando a un mundo en crecimiento sin agotar el planeta que nos alimenta?

segments.src: Sustainable, precise, data-driven farming is today's best working answer.
segments.tr: La agricultura sostenible, precisa e impulsada por datos es la mejor respuesta actual que funciona.

fr.title: [Agriculture 101 #15] Nourrir plus de personnes avec moins de ressources : agriculture durable, fermes intelligentes et récapitulatif du semestre

segments.src: > One-line summary: Sustainable agriculture keeps land productive for the long haul, and smart farms use sensors, data, and precise inputs to grow more food with less waste.
segments.tr: > Résumé d'une ligne : L'agriculture durable maintient les terres productives à long terme, et les fermes intelligentes utilisent des capteurs, des données et des intrants précis pour produire plus de nourriture avec moins de gaspillage.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concept du jour

segments.src: For most of the last century, "better farming" often meant "more" — more fertilizer, more water, more machinery, bigger fields.
segments.tr: Pendant la majeure partie du siècle dernier, « une meilleure agriculture » signifiait souvent « plus » — plus d'engrais, plus d'eau, plus de machines, des champs plus grands.

segments.src: It worked, and yields soared.
segments.tr: Cela a fonctionné, et les rendements ont grimpé.

segments.src: But it also came with a bill: eroded topsoil, polluted rivers, drained aquifers, and rising costs.
segments.tr: Mais cela a aussi eu un prix : l'érosion des sols, la pollution des rivières, l'épuisement des aquifères et la hausse des coûts.

segments.src: Sustainable agriculture is the response.
segments.tr: L'agriculture durable est la réponse.

segments.src: The idea is simple to state and hard to master: produce food in a way that stays profitable, protects the environment, and can keep going for generations without exhausting the resources it depends on.
segments.tr: L'idée est simple à énoncer et difficile à maîtriser : produire de la nourriture d'une manière qui reste rentable, protège l'environnement et peut continuer pendant des générations sans épuiser les ressources dont elle dépend.

segments.src: Three related ideas do most of the work here.
segments.tr: Trois idées connexes font la majeure partie du travail ici.

segments.src: - **Eco-friendly (sustainable) practices** aim to protect soil, water, and biodiversity. Think crop rotation, cover crops, reduced tillage, composting, and using fewer synthetic chemicals. Healthy soil holds water, stores carbon, and resists pests better.
segments.tr: - **Les pratiques écologiques (durables)** visent à protéger les sols, l'eau et la biodiversité. Pensez à la rotation des cultures, aux cultures de couverture, à la réduction du travail du sol, au compostage et à l'utilisation de moins de produits chimiques de synthèse. Un sol sain retient l'eau, stocke le carbone et résiste mieux aux ravageurs.

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture** replaces "treat the whole field the same" with "treat each spot exactly as it needs." GPS-guided tractors, variable-rate sprayers, and yield maps let a farmer apply water, seed, or fertilizer only where and when it helps — cutting waste and cost.
segments.tr: - **L'agriculture de précision** remplace « traiter tout le champ de la même manière » par « traiter chaque endroit exactement comme il en a besoin ». Les tracteurs guidés par GPS, les pulvérisateurs à débit variable et les cartes de rendement permettent à un agriculteur d'appliquer l'eau, les semences ou l'engrais uniquement où et quand cela aide — réduisant les gaspillages et les coûts.

segments.src: - **ICT convergence (the smart farm)** ties it together with technology: soil-moisture sensors, weather stations, drones, cameras, and software. Data flows in, software analyzes it, and equipment (or the farmer's phone) acts on it. A greenhouse that automatically adjusts temperature, humidity, and irrigation based on live readings is a classic smart farm.
segments.tr: - **La convergence des TIC (la ferme intelligente)** la lie ensemble avec la technologie : des capteurs d'humidité du sol, des stations météorologiques, des drones, des caméras et des logiciels. Les données s'écoulent, le logiciel les analyse, et l'équipement (ou le téléphone de l'agriculteur) y réagit. Une serre qui ajuste automatiquement la température, l'humidité et l'irrigation en fonction des lectures en direct est une ferme intelligente classique.

segments.src: Put plainly: sustainability sets the goal (last a long time without wrecking the land), and precision plus ICT are the tools that make hitting that goal realistic instead of just idealistic.
segments.tr: En clair : la durabilité fixe l'objectif (durer longtemps sans détruire les terres), et la précision plus les TIC sont les outils qui rendent la réalisation de cet objectif réaliste au lieu de simplement idéaliste.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Picture a mid-size farm in Iowa growing corn and soybeans.
segments.tr: Imaginez une ferme de taille moyenne en Iowa qui cultive du maïs et du soja.

segments.src: A generation ago, the farmer spread the same amount of nitrogen fertilizer across all 500 acres — some spots got too much (wasting money and running off into the Mississippi watershed), others too little.
segments.tr: Il y a une génération, l'agriculteur étalait la même quantité d'engrais azoté sur les 500 acres — certains endroits en recevaient trop (gaspillant de l'argent et s'écoulant dans le bassin versant du Mississippi), d'autres pas assez.

segments.src: Today the same farm might run differently.
segments.tr: Aujourd'hui, la même ferme pourrait fonctionner différemment.

segments.src: A drone flies over in early summer and images the crop; software flags the pale, underperforming patches.
segments.tr: Un drone survole la récolte au début de l'été et la photographie ; le logiciel signale les zones pâles et sous-performantes.

segments.src: The tractor's GPS auto-steers to the inch, and a variable-rate applicator dials the fertilizer up in hungry zones and down in healthy ones.
segments.tr: Le GPS du tracteur se dirige automatiquement au pouce près, et un applicateur à débit variable règle l'engrais à la hausse dans les zones affamées et à la baisse dans les zones saines.

segments.src: Soil sensors text the farmer when moisture drops.
segments.tr: Les capteurs de sol envoient un message à l'agriculteur lorsque l'humidité diminue.

segments.src: Over the season this can trim input costs by tens of dollars per acre — real money when diesel runs a few dollars a gallon and fertilizer prices swing hard — while keeping less nitrogen out of local streams.
segments.tr: Au cours de la saison, cela peut réduire les coûts d'intrants de dizaines de dollars par acre — de l'argent réel lorsque le diesel coûte quelques dollars par gallon et que les prix des engrais fluctuent fortement — tout en gardant moins d'azote hors des cours d'eau locaux.

segments.src: Scale it down and it's your backyard too: a smart sprinkler that checks the forecast before watering, or a garden moisture probe on your phone, is the same principle.
segments.tr: Réduisez-le et c'est votre cour arrière aussi : un arroseur intelligent qui vérifie la prévision avant d'arroser, ou une sonde d'humidité du jardin sur votre téléphone, est le même principe.

segments.src: Sense the actual need, then apply exactly that much.
segments.tr: Détectez le besoin réel, puis appliquez exactement cela.

segments.src: That is precision and ICT working for a home gardener instead of a 500-acre operation.
segments.tr: C'est la précision et les TIC fonctionnant pour un jardinier amateur au lieu d'une exploitation de 500 acres.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Récapitulatif en trois lignes

segments.src: 1. Sustainable agriculture means producing food profitably and long-term without exhausting soil, water, and biodiversity.
segments.tr: 1. L'agriculture durable signifie produire de la nourriture de manière rentable et à long terme sans épuiser les sols, l'eau et la biodiversité.

segments.src: 2. Precision agriculture applies inputs site-specifically ("only where needed"), cutting waste and cost.
segments.tr: 2. L'agriculture de précision applique les intrants de manière site-spécifique (« uniquement là où nécessaire »), réduisant les gaspillages et les coûts.

segments.src: 3. Smart farms use ICT — sensors, data, and automation — to sense conditions and respond precisely and quickly.
segments.tr: 3. Les fermes intelligentes utilisent les TIC — capteurs, données et automatisation — pour détecter les conditions et réagir précisément et rapidement.

in.title: [Pertanian 101 #15] Memberi Makan Lebih Banyak Orang Dengan Sumber Daya Lebih Sedikit: Pertanian Berkelanjutan, Pertanian Cerdas, dan Ringkasan Semester Lengkap

segments.src: > One-line summary: Sustainable agriculture keeps land productive for the long haul, and smart farms use sensors, data, and precise inputs to grow more food with less waste.
segments.tr: > Ringkasan satu baris: Pertanian berkelanjutan menjaga lahan tetap produktif untuk jangka panjang, dan pertanian cerdas menggunakan sensor, data, dan masukan presisi untuk menghasilkan lebih banyak makanan dengan limbah lebih sedikit.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: For most of the last century, "better farming" often meant "more" — more fertilizer, more water, more machinery, bigger fields.
segments.tr: Selama sebagian besar abad terakhir, "pertanian lebih baik" sering berarti "lebih banyak" — lebih banyak pupuk, lebih banyak air, lebih banyak mesin, ladang lebih besar.

segments.src: It worked, and yields soared.
segments.tr: Itu berhasil, dan hasil panen melonjak.

segments.src: But it also came with a bill: eroded topsoil, polluted rivers, drained aquifers, and rising costs.
segments.tr: Tetapi itu juga datang dengan biaya: lapisan tanah tererosi, sungai tercemar, akuifer yang terkuras, dan biaya yang meningkat.

segments.src: Sustainable agriculture is the response.
segments.tr: Pertanian berkelanjutan adalah jawabannya.

segments.src: The idea is simple to state and hard to master: produce food in a way that stays profitable, protects the environment, and can keep going for generations without exhausting the resources it depends on.
segments.tr: Idenya sederhana untuk dinyatakan dan sulit untuk dikuasai: menghasilkan makanan dengan cara yang tetap menguntungkan, melindungi lingkungan, dan dapat terus berlanjut selama beberapa generasi tanpa menguras sumber daya yang bergantung padanya.

segments.src: Three related ideas do most of the work here.
segments.tr: Tiga ide terkait melakukan sebagian besar pekerjaan di sini.

segments.src: - **Eco-friendly (sustainable) practices** aim to protect soil, water, and biodiversity. Think crop rotation, cover crops, reduced tillage, composting, and using fewer synthetic chemicals. Healthy soil holds water, stores carbon, and resists pests better.
segments.tr: - **Praktik ramah lingkungan (berkelanjutan)** bertujuan untuk melindungi tanah, air, dan keanekaragaman hayati. Pikirkan rotasi tanaman, tanaman penutup, pengolahan tanah berkurang, pengomposan, dan menggunakan lebih sedikit bahan kimia sintetis. Tanah yang sehat menahan air, menyimpan karbon, dan lebih tahan terhadap hama.

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture** replaces "treat the whole field the same" with "treat each spot exactly as it needs." GPS-guided tractors, variable-rate sprayers, and yield maps let a farmer apply water, seed, or fertilizer only where and when it helps — cutting waste and cost.
segments.tr: - **Pertanian presisi** menggantikan "perlakukan seluruh ladang sama" dengan "perlakukan setiap tempat persis seperti yang dibutuhkan." Traktor dengan panduan GPS, penyemprot tingkat variabel, dan peta hasil panen memungkinkan petani menerapkan air, benih, atau pupuk hanya di mana dan kapan pun membantu — mengurangi pemborosan dan biaya.

segments.src: - **ICT convergence (the smart farm)** ties it together with technology: soil-moisture sensors, weather stations, drones, cameras, and software. Data flows in, software analyzes it, and equipment (or the farmer's phone) acts on it. A greenhouse that automatically adjusts temperature, humidity, and irrigation based on live readings is a classic smart farm.
segments.tr: - **Konvergensi ICT (pertanian cerdas)** mengikatnya dengan teknologi: sensor kelembaban tanah, stasiun cuaca, drone, kamera, dan perangkat lunak. Data mengalir masuk, perangkat lunak menganalisisnya, dan peralatan (atau ponsel petani) bertindak berdasarkannya. Rumah kaca yang secara otomatis menyesuaikan suhu, kelembaban, dan irigasi berdasarkan pembacaan langsung adalah pertanian cerdas klasik.

segments.src: Put plainly: sustainability sets the goal (last a long time without wrecking the land), and precision plus ICT are the tools that make hitting that goal realistic instead of just idealistic.
segments.tr: Sederhana saja: keberlanjutan menetapkan tujuan (bertahan lama tanpa merusak lahan), dan presisi ditambah ICT adalah alat yang membuat mencapai tujuan itu realistis daripada hanya idealistis.

de.title: [Landwirtschaft 101 #15] Mehr Menschen mit weniger Ressourcen ernähren: Nachhaltige Landwirtschaft, intelligente Höfe und ein Semesterrückblick

segments.src: > One-line summary: Sustainable agriculture keeps land productive for the long haul, and smart farms use sensors, data, and precise inputs to grow more food with less waste.
segments.tr: > Einzeilige Zusammenfassung: Nachhaltige Landwirtschaft hält Land langfristig produktiv, und intelligente Höfe nutzen Sensoren, Daten und präzise Eingaben, um mehr Nahrung mit weniger Abfall zu produzieren.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Heutiges Konzept

segments.src: For most of the last century, "better farming" often meant "more" — more fertilizer, more water, more machinery, bigger fields.
segments.tr: Während des größten Teils des letzten Jahrhunderts bedeutete "bessere Landwirtschaft" oft "mehr" — mehr Dünger, mehr Wasser, mehr Maschinen, größere Felder.

segments.src: It worked, and yields soared.
segments.tr: Es funktionierte, und die Erträge schnellten in die Höhe.

segments.src: But it also came with a bill: eroded topsoil, polluted rivers, drained aquifers, and rising costs.
segments.tr: Aber es hatte auch einen Preis: erodierte Oberböden, verschmutzte Flüsse, verbrauchte Grundwasserleiter und steigende Kosten.

segments.src: Sustainable agriculture is the response.
segments.tr: Nachhaltige Landwirtschaft ist die Antwort.

segments.src: The idea is simple to state and hard to master: produce food in a way that stays profitable, protects the environment, and can keep going for generations without exhausting the resources it depends on.
segments.tr: Die Idee ist einfach zu formulieren und schwer zu meistern: Lebensmittel auf eine Weise produzieren, die profitabel bleibt, die Umwelt schützt und für Generationen fortbestand haben kann, ohne die Ressourcen auszuschöpfen, von denen sie abhängt.

segments.src: Three related ideas do most of the work here.
segments.tr: Drei verwandte Ideen leisten hier die meiste Arbeit.

segments.src: - **Eco-friendly (sustainable) practices** aim to protect soil, water, and biodiversity. Think crop rotation, cover crops, reduced tillage, composting, and using fewer synthetic chemicals. Healthy soil holds water, stores carbon, and resists pests better.
segments.tr: - **Umweltfreundliche (nachhaltige) Praktiken** zielen darauf ab, Boden, Wasser und Biodiversität zu schützen. Denken Sie an Fruchtfolge, Zwischenfrüchte, reduzierte Bodenbearbeitung, Kompostierung und die Verwendung weniger synthetischer Chemikalien. Gesunder Boden speichert Wasser, lagert Kohlenstoff ein und widersetzt sich Schädlingen besser.

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture** replaces "treat the whole field the same" with "treat each spot exactly as it needs." GPS-guided tractors, variable-rate sprayers, and yield maps let a farmer apply water, seed, or fertilizer only where and when it helps — cutting waste and cost.
segments.tr: - **Präzisionslandwirtschaft** ersetzt "das ganze Feld gleich behandeln" durch "jeden Fleck genau so behandeln, wie es nötig ist." GPS-gesteuerte Traktoren, Sprüher mit variabler Rate und Ertragskarten ermöglichen es einem Landwirt, Wasser, Saatgut oder Dünger nur dort und dann anzuwenden, wo es hilft — wodurch Verschwendung und Kosten reduziert werden.

segments.src: - **ICT convergence (the smart farm)** ties it together with technology: soil-moisture sensors, weather stations, drones, cameras, and software. Data flows in, software analyzes it, and equipment (or the farmer's phone) acts on it. A greenhouse that automatically adjusts temperature, humidity, and irrigation based on live readings is a classic smart farm.
segments.tr: - **IKT-Konvergenz (der intelligente Hof)** verbindet das alles mit Technologie: Bodenfeuchtesensoren, Wetterstationen, Drohnen, Kameras und Software. Daten fließen ein, Software analysiert sie und Ausrüstung (oder das Telefon des Landwirts) reagiert darauf. Ein Gewächshaus, das Temperatur, Luftfeuchtigkeit und Bewässerung automatisch basierend auf Live-Messwerten anpasst, ist ein klassischer intelligenter Hof.

segments.src: Put plainly: sustainability sets the goal (last a long time without wrecking the land), and precision plus ICT are the tools that make hitting that goal realistic instead of just idealistic.
segments.tr: Einfach gesagt: Nachhaltigkeit setzt das Ziel (lange Zeit andauern, ohne das Land zu zerstören), und Präzision plus IKT sind die Werkzeuge, die es realistisch machen, dieses Ziel zu erreichen, anstatt es nur idealistisch zu sein.

segments.src: But it also came with a bill: eroded topsoil, polluted rivers, drained aquifers, and rising costs.
segments.tr: Nhưng nó cũng phải trả giá: đất canh tác bị xói mòn, các con sông bị ô nhiễm, các tầng chứa nước bị cạn kiệt, và chi phí tăng.

segments.src: Sustainable agriculture is the response.
segments.tr: Nông nghiệp bền vững là phản ứng.

segments.src: The idea is simple to state and hard to master: produce food in a way that stays profitable, protects the environment, and can keep going for generations without exhausting the resources it depends on.
segments.tr: Ý tưởng này đơn giản để phát biểu nhưng khó để thành thạo: sản xuất thực phẩm theo cách vừa có lợi nhuận, bảo vệ môi trường, và có thể tiếp tục trong nhiều thế hệ mà không cạn kiệt các tài nguyên mà nó phụ thuộc vào.

segments.src: Three related ideas do most of the work here.
segments.tr: Ba ý tưởng liên quan thực hiện hầu hết công việc ở đây.

segments.src: - **Eco-friendly (sustainable) practices** aim to protect soil, water, and biodiversity. Think crop rotation, cover crops, reduced tillage, composting, and using fewer synthetic chemicals. Healthy soil holds water, stores carbon, and resists pests better.
segments.tr: - **Các thực hành thân thiện với môi trường (bền vững)** nhằm bảo vệ đất đai, nước, và đa dạng sinh học. Hãy nghĩ về luân canh cây trồng, cây trồng che phủ, giảm cày sâu, trộn compost, và sử dụng ít hóa chất tổng hợp hơn. Đất khỏe mạnh giữ nước, lưu trữ carbon, và chống lại sâu bệnh tốt hơn.

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture** replaces "treat the whole field the same" with "treat each spot exactly as it needs." GPS-guided tractors, variable-rate sprayers, and yield maps let a farmer apply water, seed, or fertilizer only where and when it helps — cutting waste and cost.
segments.tr: - **Nông nghiệp chính xác** thay thế "xử lý toàn bộ cánh đồng giống nhau" bằng "xử lý mỗi điểm theo đúng nhu cầu của nó." Máy kéo hướng dẫn GPS, máy phun thay đổi tỷ lệ, và bản đồ năng suất cho phép nông dân áp dụng nước, hạt giống, hoặc phân bón chỉ khi và ở những nơi nó giúp ích — giảm lãng phí và chi phí.

segments.src: - **ICT convergence (the smart farm)** ties it together with technology: soil-moisture sensors, weather stations, drones, cameras, and software. Data flows in, software analyzes it, and equipment (or the farmer's phone) acts on it. A greenhouse that automatically adjusts temperature, humidity, and irrigation based on live readings is a classic smart farm.
segments.tr: - **Sự hội tụ ICT (nông trại thông minh)** kết nối nó với công nghệ: cảm biến độ ẩm đất, trạm thời tiết, máy bay không người lái, camera, và phần mềm. Dữ liệu chảy vào, phần mềm phân tích nó, và thiết bị (hoặc điện thoại của nông dân) hành động dựa trên nó. Một nhà kính tự động điều chỉnh nhiệt độ, độ ẩm, và tưới nước dựa trên các lần đọc trực tiếp là một nông trại thông minh điển hình.

segments.src: Put plainly: sustainability sets the goal (last a long time without wrecking the land), and precision plus ICT are the tools that make hitting that goal realistic instead of just idealistic.
segments.tr: Nói một cách rõ ràng: tính bền vững đặt ra mục tiêu (tồn tại lâu dài mà không phá hủy đất đai), và độ chính xác cộng với ICT là những công cụ giúp đạt được mục tiêu đó một cách thực tế thay vì chỉ lý tưởng.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Trong cuộc sống hàng ngày

segments.src: Picture a mid-size farm in Iowa growing corn and soybeans.
segments.tr: Hãy tưởng tượng một nông trại có quy mô trung bình ở Iowa trồng ngô và đậu tương.

segments.src: A generation ago, the farmer spread the same amount of nitrogen fertilizer across all 500 acres — some spots got too much (wasting money and running off into the Mississippi watershed), others too little.
segments.tr: Một thế hệ trước, nông dân trải đều cùng một lượng phân bón nitơ trên toàn bộ 500 mẫu Anh — một số nơi nhận được quá nhiều (lãng phí tiền và chảy vào lưu vực Mississippi), những nơi khác quá ít.

segments.src: Today the same farm might run differently.
segments.tr: Ngày hôm nay nông trại tương tự có thể hoạt động khác đi.

segments.src: A drone flies over in early summer and images the crop; software flags the pale, underperforming patches.
segments.tr: Một máy bay không người lái bay qua vào đầu mùa hè và chụp ảnh vụ mùa; phần mềm đánh dấu các mảng nhợt nhạt, kém hiệu quả.

segments.src: The tractor's GPS auto-steers to the inch, and a variable-rate applicator dials the fertilizer up in hungry zones and down in healthy ones.
segments.tr: GPS của máy kéo tự động lái đến từng inch, và một bộ phân phối thay đổi tỷ lệ điều chỉnh phân bón lên trong các vùng thiếu dinh dưỡng và xuống trong những vùng khỏe mạnh.

segments.src: Soil sensors text the farmer when moisture drops.
segments.tr: Cảm biến đất gửi tin nhắn cho nông dân khi độ ẩm giảm.

segments.src: Over the season this can trim input costs by tens of dollars per acre — real money when diesel runs a few dollars a gallon and fertilizer prices swing hard — while keeping less nitrogen out of local streams.
segments.tr: Trong suốt mùa vụ này có thể giảm chi phí đầu vào hàng chục đô la trên mỗi mẫu Anh — tiền thật khi dầu diesel chạy vài đô la một gallon và giá phân bón dao động mạnh — đồng thời giữ lại ít nitơ chảy ra khỏi các dòng nước địa phương hơn.

segments.src: Scale it down and it's your backyard too: a smart sprinkler that checks the forecast before watering, or a garden moisture probe on your phone, is the same principle.
segments.tr: Giảm quy mô nó xuống và nó cũng là sân sau của bạn: một bộ tưới nước thông minh kiểm tra dự báo thời tiết trước khi tưới, hoặc một sonde độ ẩm vườn trên điện thoại của bạn, là cùng một nguyên lý.

segments.src: Sense the actual need, then apply exactly that much.
segments.tr: Cảm nhận nhu cầu thực tế, sau đó áp dụng đúng số lượng đó.

segments.src: That is precision and ICT working for a home gardener instead of a 500-acre operation.
segments.tr: Đó là độ chính xác và ICT hoạt động cho một người làm vườn tại nhà thay vì một hoạt động 500 mẫu Anh.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Tóm tắt ba dòng

segments.src: 1. Sustainable agriculture means producing food profitably and long-term without exhausting soil, water, and biodiversity.
segments.tr: 1. Nông nghiệp bền vững có nghĩa là sản xuất thực phẩm có lợi nhuận và dài hạn mà không cạn kiệt đất đai, nước, và đa dạng sinh học.

segments.src: 2. Precision agriculture applies inputs site-specifically ("only where needed"), cutting waste and cost.
segments.tr: 2. Nông nghiệp chính xác áp dụng đầu vào cụ thể theo địa điểm ("chỉ nơi cần thiết"), cắt giảm lãng phí và chi phí.

segments.src: 3. Smart farms use ICT — sensors, data, and automation — to sense conditions and respond precisely and quickly.
segments.tr: 3. Nông trại thông minh sử dụng ICT — cảm biến, dữ liệu, và tự động hóa — để cảm nhận điều kiện và phản ứng chính xác và nhanh chóng.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Bài kiểm tra tự học

segments.src: 1. Which best describes the core goal of sustainable agriculture?
segments.tr: 1. Cái nào mô tả tốt nhất mục tiêu cốt lõi của nông nghiệp bền vững?

segments.src: - A) Maximize this year's yield at any cost
segments.tr: - A) Tối đa hóa năng suất năm nay bằng bất kỳ cách nào

segments.tr: - B) Sản xuất thực phẩm dài hạn trong khi bảo vệ đất đai, nước, và đa dạng sinh học

segments.src: - C) Replace all farming with laboratory-grown food
segments.tr: - C) Thay thế tất cả nông nghiệp bằng thực phẩm được trồng trong phòng thí nghiệm

segments.src: - D) Farm only without any machinery
segments.tr: - D) Chỉ nông nghiệp mà không có bất kỳ máy móc nào

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Các thuật ngữ hôm nay

segments.src: - **Sustainable agriculture**: Farming that stays productive and profitable long-term while protecting soil, water, and ecosystems.
segments.tr: - **Nông nghiệp bền vững**: Nông nghiệp vẫn năng suất cao và có lợi nhuận lâu dài trong khi bảo vệ đất đai, nước, và hệ sinh thái.

segments.src: - **Precision agriculture**: Managing fields site-specifically so inputs (water, seed, fertilizer) go only where and when they are needed.
segments.tr: - **Nông nghiệp chính xác**: Quản lý các cánh đồng cụ thể theo địa điểm để đầu vào (nước, hạt giống, phân bón) chỉ đi đến những nơi và khi chúng cần thiết.

segments.src: - **ICT convergence / smart farm**: Combining sensors, data, and automation so a farm can monitor conditions and respond in real time.
segments.tr: - **Sự hội tụ ICT / nông trại thông minh**: Kết hợp cảm biến, dữ liệu, và tự động hóa để một nông trại có thể giám sát điều kiện và phản ứng theo thời gian thực.

segments.src: - **Variable-rate application**: Adjusting the amount of an input across a field based on local need, rather than a single fixed rate.
segments.tr: - **Ứng dụng tỷ lệ thay đổi**: Điều chỉnh lượng đầu vào trên toàn bộ cánh đồng dựa trên nhu cầu địa phương, thay vì một tỷ lệ cố định duy nhất.

segments.src: - **Cover crop**: A plant grown mainly to protect and enrich the soil between main harvests, not to be sold.
segments.tr: - **Cây trồng che phủ**: Một loại cây được trồng chủ yếu để bảo vệ và làm giàu đất giữa các vụ thu hoạch chính, không để bán.

segments.src: *Answers: 1) B — sustainability is about long-term productivity plus environmental protection, not maximizing one season.
segments.tr: *Câu trả lời: 1) B — tính bền vững là về năng suất dài hạn cộng với bảo vệ môi trường, không phải tối đa hóa một mùa vụ.

segments.src: 2) X — it is the opposite; precision means varying inputs by location instead of applying a uniform amount.
segments.tr: 2) X — nó là ngược lại; độ chính xác có nghĩa là thay đổi đầu vào theo vị trí thay vì áp dụng một lượng đồng nhất.

segments.src: 3) A — a sensor-driven, self-adjusting greenhouse is the textbook smart farm; the others lack the sense-analyze-act loop.*
segments.tr: 3) A — một nhà kính được điều khiển bởi cảm biến, tự điều chỉnh là nông trại thông minh trong sách giáo khoa; những cái khác thiếu vòng lặp cảm nhận-phân tích-hành động.*

segments.src: Semester wrap-up: across these 15 lectures we moved from what agriculture is, through soil, water, plants, crops, livestock, and pests, and arrived here — where all of it comes together under one question: how do we keep feeding a growing world without using up the planet that feeds us?
segments.tr: Tóm tắt học kỳ: trong 15 bài giảng này chúng ta đã chuyển động từ nông nghiệp là gì, thông qua đất đai, nước, thực vật, cây trồng, chăn nuôi, và sâu bệnh, và đến đây — nơi tất cả chúng hội tụ dưới một câu hỏi: làm thế nào chúng ta có thể tiếp tục nuôi sống một thế giới đang tăng trưởng mà không sử dụng hết hành tinh nuôi sống chúng ta?

segments.src: Sustainable, precise, data-driven farming is today's best working answer.
segments.tr: Nông nghiệp bền vững, chính xác, được điều khiển bởi dữ liệu là câu trả lời hoạt động tốt nhất ngày hôm nay.
